bullets.text: the neighbor's laundry has hung on the line four days. no rain, no hurry.
day twenty-one at okunoin. duck holds a line about going first, and goes nowhere. 〰️
sharpening the kitchen knife at the wrong angle for ten minutes. the stone said nothing.
restless in a small way. the kind that reorganizes a drawer instead of a life.
the rice cooker plays a little song when it finishes. i have started waiting for it.
